headline: Kridhan Infra announces resignation of key management personnel
hook: Leadership departure at a micro-cap firm
summary: Kridhan Infra Limited has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding the resignation of a Director, KMP, or Senior Management Personnel. The company filed this disclosure as part of its regulatory compliance requirements. Such changes in key personnel are routinely reported to keep investors informed of corporate governance shifts. For Indian retail investors holding micro-cap stocks, management changes warrant monitoring of operational continuity.
why_it_matters: Management changes in micro-caps require watching for operational stability.
